title: Present init presets and swap the site mascot

demand.statement: Readers of the README, the docs guide, and the public site must see the five init presets that are already on main: python, python-platform, fastapi, django, and rag. The CLI user must find init --preset, init --list-presets, --force-config, and preset show in the CLI reference. The site hero must use the same static card image as the README, docs/assets/retornatus-mascot-readme.webp. Out of scope: changing preset behavior, a version bump, merge, and publish. Ship and AI rules must be described as checks that evidence ran, not as quality grades.
